slate_summary: The 2026-09-17 WNBA slate lacks critical foundational data required for confident selection. No player season averages, L10/L5/L3 volume trends, or team-level statistics were provided in the research section. While external odds and player prop lines are present, the absence of baseline production data, minutes trends, usage rates, and hit-rate matrices prevents meaningful differentiation between value bets and traps. Game context (playoff implications, seed races) is noted in the news but cannot substitute for quantitative performance evidence. The framework requires prediction confidence to rest on actual statistical performance, not inference from headlines alone. Under these constraints, no bet meets the 72+ confidence threshold.
